task.instructions:
The file `checkouts.csv` is in your working directory. It has a header row and two columns:
  - `genre` (text): the name of a genre
  - `checkouts` (integer): how many times books in that genre were borrowed last year
Read the file and draw a vertical bar chart with matplotlib: one bar per row.
Requirements:
- Keep the bars in the same order the rows appear in the file. Do not sort them.
- The genre names must be the x tick labels.
- The y axis must start at 0.
- Print each bar's checkout count above (or on) the bar as a plain integer with no thousands separator, for example `4128`.
- Give the chart a title and label both axes.
